notes: 2.3.2: every published build now has its own unique version, so the jar name ALWAYS changes when the file changes. /bridge status shows both the running version AND the running jar's sha, and /bridge update prints sha's too - if the sha next to 'current' does not match the sha in this manifest, you are NOT running this build. Apply mechanics unchanged: /bridge update apply installs the new jar and the server restarts; the restart (not the updater) is what takes the couple of minutes. From 2.3.1: biome scans are command-only and scan the WHOLE world in one go (background timer removed) - run /bridge biomes rescan all once after updating. Includes the hollow-chunk fix (top biome layer + single-entry palettes with no data array). Requires the 20260101000300_biomes migration and the 20260101000500_biomes_snapshot RPC.
